Subject: Solara Health — kickoff + network review (private deployment)

Karthik / Aditya,

Thanks for taking this on. Solara is ready to move from contract to engineering. I kicked off the internal onboarding checklist but they have a few open questions around VPC peering vs. Private Endpoint, and want to schedule a short networking review with their NetOps and our infra team.

Attached: solara_network_diagram_v2.pdf (customer), redwood_private_install_checklist.xlsx (our standard checklist).

Quick background:
- Customer: Solara Health (HIPAA workload), prefers VPC peering but is open to Private Endpoint for regulatory reasons.
- Desired window: target production enablement in Q4.
- Constraint: Solara requires egress restrictions from the inference private endpoints and wants all traffic to be logged to their SIEM.

Ask: can we do a 30–45 minute network-design sync with Solara NetOps this week? Proposed times below. Also please review the network diagram before the call and flag any missing firewall rules or IAM needs.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 8/24 10:00–10:45
- Wed 8/25 15:00–15:45

Thanks — I looped Linda for availability.

Best,

Subject: Re: Solara Health — kickoff + network review (private deployment)

Monica — thanks for the context. I reviewed the network diagram and a couple of immediate notes:

1) If Solara wants strict egress control and SIEM integration, Private Endpoint (AWS PrivateLink style) gives better control over per-endpoint ACLs and simplifies routing (no cross-VPC route tables to manage). Peering can work but you'll need cross-account route updates and careful NAT/firewall placement.

2) We need the CIDR ranges for their peering VPCs and the ASN if they plan to use transit gateways. Also confirm whether they require ingress whitelisting by Elastic IPs (we can provide egress/static IPs from our dedicated NAT if needed).

3) On-prem package: please confirm if they want the air-gapped installer or the standard private package that still reaches our control plane for metrics. If the former, we'll need SSH access windows to their build host during install.

I can take the network review call but want Aditya on for install/runbook details. I can do Tue 8/24 10:00 PST. Linda — does that work for you and NetOps?

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Thanks, Monica. Tue 8/24 10:00 PST works for our NetOps team (I'll add Chris and Anika from NetOps). A few pre-call notes from our side:

- Solara prefers VPC peering for dev/staging to avoid extra VPC endpoints, but we need private endpoints for prod due to audit controls. We want a hybrid approach: peering for non-PHI traffic, Private Endpoint for PHI inference.
- Attached a small vpc_peer_request.json with our preferred CIDR ranges and proposed TGW usage.
- For SIEM, we will receive logs via a collector in our VPC; need to confirm that Redwood can forward structured audit logs to our collector address (we can receive via syslog/HTTPS).

We also have two scheduling constraints: maintenance window for production networking changes is Sundays 01:00–05:00 UTC, and our security approvals require a runbook 72 hours before any prod change.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.
